
/* ---- development panel ---- */
const panel = document.getElementById('panel'), phone = document.querySelector('.phone');
phone.classList.add('panel-open');
document.getElementById('panelToggle').onclick = e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  const c = panel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  phone.classList.toggle('panel-open', !c);
  e.currentTarget.textContent = c ? 'â–¼' : 'â–²';
  e.currentTarget.title = c ? 'Open development panel' : 'Collapse panel';
};

/* ---- diary ---- */
const diary = document.getElementById('diary');
document.getElementById('diaryBtn').onclick = e => {
  e.stopPropagation(); diary.classList.add('on'); pageFlip();
};
document.getElementById('diaryClose').onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); closeDiary(); };
diary.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === diary) closeDiary(); });
function closeDiary(){ diary.classList.remove('on'); }

/* page-flip, synthesised: filtered noise burst with a fast decay.
   no audio file needed, and it retunes by ear in one line */
let actx = null;
function pageFlip(){
  try {
    actx = actx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if (actx.state === 'suspended') actx.resume();
    const dur = 0.32, sr = actx.sampleRate;
    const buf = actx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
      const t = i / d.length;
      // two brushes: the lift, then the settle
      const env = Math.exp(-9 * t) * (1 - t) + 0.5 * Math.exp(-24 * Math.abs(t - 0.42));
      d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * env;
    }
    const src = actx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
    const bp = actx.createBiquadFilter(); bp.type = 'bandpass';
    bp.frequency.value = 1900; bp.Q.value = 0.7;
    const hp = actx.createBiquadFilter(); hp.type = 'highpass'; hp.frequency.value = 700;
    const g = actx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.22;
    src.connect(bp); bp.connect(hp); hp.connect(g); g.connect(actx.destination);
    src.start();
  } catch (err) { /* audio blocked before first gesture â€” fine */ }
}

/* what the shelf looks like at each storage tier â€” design preview only */
const TIERS = {
  sand:    {slots:5,  label:'stored in the sand',
    inv:[['stone',2],['wood',5],['fiber',2],['coconut',1]]},
  satchel: {slots:10,  label:'woven satchel',
    inv:[['stone',3],['wood',5],['fiber',4],['coconut',2],['string',2],['flint',1]]},
  wooden:  {slots:15, label:'wooden box',
    inv:[['stone',4],['wood',8],['fiber',5],['string',3],['flint',1],['tinder',3],
         ['stone_axe',1],['stone_spear',1],['fish_large',2],['coconut_cup',1]]},
  storage: {slots:20, label:'storage box',
    inv:[['stone',6],['wood',10],['fiber',8],['string',6],['metal',3],['flint',1],['tinder',5],['metal_axe',1],['fishing_rod',1],['stone_spear',1],['pan',1],['fish_large',3],['can',2],['coconut',5],['canister',1],['coconut_cup',1],['bandage',3],['medicine',1],['volleyball',1],['recorder',1]]}
};
const LOCKHINT = {sand:'Craft a satchel', satchel:'Build a wooden box',
                  wooden:'Build a storage box', storage:'Supporter Â· +5'};
let tier = 'sand';

const grid = document.getElementById('grid'), detail = document.getElementById('detail'),
      slotCap = document.getElementById('slotCap');

function renderItems(){
  const T = TIERS[tier];
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  T.inv.forEach(([key, qty]) => {
    const it = IT[key];
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'slot';
    b.innerHTML = '<img class="ic" src="' + ART[it.a] + '" alt="">' +
                  '<span class="nm">' + it.n + '</span>' +
                  (qty > 1 ? '<span class="qty">x' + qty + '</span>' : '');
    b.onclick = ev => { ev.stopPropagation(); selectItem(key, b); };
    grid.appendChild(b);
  });
  const free = T.slots - T.inv.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < free; i++) {
    const e = document.createElement('div');
    e.className = 'slot free';
    grid.appendChild(e);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const l = document.createElement('div');
    l.className = 'slot locked';
    l.innerHTML = '<span class="lk">+</span><span class="nm">' +
                  (i === 0 ? LOCKHINT[tier] : '') + '</span>';
    grid.appendChild(l);
  }
  slotCap.textContent = T.inv.length + ' of ' + T.slots + ' slots used Â· ' + T.label;
  document.querySelectorAll('.tiers span').forEach(x =>
    x.classList.toggle('now', x.dataset.tier === tier));
  clearDetail();
}
function clearDetail(){
  detail.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">' +
    (tier === 'sand' ? 'Four slots, and the sand is not a container.<br>Tap something to look at it.'
                     : 'Tap something to look at it.') + '</div>';
  grid.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(s => s.removeAttribute('data-sel'));
}
function selectItem(key, el){
  const it = IT[key];
  grid.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(s => s.removeAttribute('data-sel'));
  el.setAttribute('data-sel','');
  const acts = it.t.startsWith('Food') ? ['Eat','Destroy']
             : it.t.startsWith('Container') ? ['Drink','Set outside','Destroy']
             : it.t.startsWith('Medicine') ? ['Apply','Destroy']
             : it.t.startsWith('Comfort') ? (key === 'recorder' ? ['Play','Destroy'] : ['Destroy'])
             : ['Craft with','Destroy'];
  detail.innerHTML =
    '<div class="dhead"><img src="' + ART[it.a] + '" alt="">' +
      '<div><h3>' + it.n + '</h3><div class="meta">' + it.t + '</div></div></div>' +
    '<p>' + it.d + '</p>' +
    (it.g.length ? '<div class="tags">' + it.g.map(t =>
      '<span class="tag ' + t[0] + '">' + t[1] + '</span>').join('') + '</div>' : '') +
    '<div class="acts">' + acts.map(a =>
      '<button' + (a === 'Destroy' ? ' class="danger"' : '') + '>' + a + '</button>').join('') +
    '</div>';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.tiers span').forEach(x => x.onclick = e => {
  e.stopPropagation(); tier = x.dataset.tier; renderItems();
});
renderItems();

const items = document.getElementById('items');
document.getElementById('itemsBtn').onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); items.classList.add('on'); };
document.getElementById('itemsClose').onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); closeItems(); };
items.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === items) closeItems(); });
function closeItems(){ items.classList.remove('on'); }
</script>
